message.text:
The compiled React frontend is embedded into the Go binary via `go:embed`. It is served as static files with SPA fallback by `FrontendService`.

Mechanism: `go:embed` of `dist/*` plus Echo static middleware with SPA fallback. File: `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`. The HTTP server wiring is in `server/server.go` line 72.

q27.
go:embed of `dist/*` (Echo static + SPA fallback); server/router/frontend/frontend.go

`//go:embed dist/*` loads the compiled React build into `embeddedFiles`. `FrontendService.Serve` serves it with Echo `middleware.Static` and `spaFallbackMiddleware`. `server/server.go` starts that service in production.
